feature: Tab EHT Details dan REP Details di form Create Parking Offence Notice (officer mengisi data coupon EHT dan data REP bersama notice)
note: Form create manual punya dua tab tambahan (EHT Details, REP Details) yang ikut dikirim di payload staff-create-notice (MapAPINoticeREP, MapAPINoticeDetailREP, MapAPINoticeDetailCoupon) dan dicek ValidREPEHTSave sebelum submit. Story OCMS5.1 sampai OCMS5.5 hanya menyebut field offence umum; tidak ada story dalam chunk ini yang meminta data coupon/REP. Mungkin tercakup story epic lain, perlu dicek di chunk lain.
note_en: The manual create form has two extra tabs (EHT Details, REP Details) whose data is sent in the staff-create-notice payload (MapAPINoticeREP, MapAPINoticeDetailREP, MapAPINoticeDetailCoupon) and checked by ValidREPEHTSave before submit. Stories OCMS5.1 to OCMS5.5 only mention general offence fields; no story in this chunk asks for coupon/REP data. It may be covered by a story in another epic and needs checking in another chunk.

feature: Form dan upload untuk notice tipe E, U, A, T (Payment Evasion, Unauthorized Use of Parking Lots, Offence Type A/T) di modul Notice
note: Code form E/U dan template upload Payment Evasion/Unauthorized Use masih ada, tetapi route create E/U di-comment (App.tsx:129-130) dan dropdown tipe notice hanya menawarkan O (NoticeBasicForm.tsx:118), jadi tidak bisa dipakai officer dari UI. Story chunk ini hanya parking offence; tidak diklaim.
note_en: The E/U form code and the Payment Evasion/Unauthorized Use upload templates still exist, but the E/U create routes are commented out (App.tsx:129-130) and the notice type dropdown only offers O (NoticeBasicForm.tsx:118), so an officer cannot use them from the UI. The stories in this chunk cover parking offences only; not claimed.
